entities.name: PMID:27514378
observations: In cultured ovine oviduct epithelial cells, LPS increased SBD-1 mRNA in a concentration- and time-dependent manner; p38 inhibitors attenuated this response.
LPS induced p38 phosphorylation, and TLR4 neutralization reduced p38 phosphorylation and SBD-1 induction.

entities.name: Lipopolysaccharide
observations: LPS stimulated SBD-1 mRNA expression and p38 phosphorylation in cultured ovine oviduct epithelial cells at the reported experimental concentrations.

entities.name: SBD-1
observations: SBD-1 mRNA increased after LPS exposure in cultured ovine oviduct epithelial cells; SB203580 and SB202190 attenuated the response.
The retrieved evidence concerns mRNA and does not establish increased SBD-1 protein or an in-vivo response.

entities.name: p38 MAPK signaling
observations: LPS induced p38 phosphorylation, and pharmacologic p38 inhibition reduced LPS-stimulated SBD-1 mRNA expression in cultured ovine oviduct epithelial cells.
JNK inhibition had no significant effect and ERK inhibition had only a minor effect, supporting p38 as a major pathway rather than necessarily the sole pathway.

entities.name: Ovine oviduct epithelial cells
observations: Cultured ovine oviduct epithelial cells were used as the experimental model; cell identity was supported by CK-18 immunostaining.
